description: What typically slows sites on a website platform down (WordPress, WooCommerce, Squarespace, Wix, Duda, Tilda, Divi, Bitrix), measured across the WebSpeed audit base: the share of audited sites of that platform with each bottleneck, the number of audits and the snapshot date, plus published before/after teardowns and studies for the platform. Use when the user asks why their Squarespace / WordPress / … site is slow, what is normal for the platform, or what they can fix on it.

platform.description: Platform name, e.g. WordPress, Squarespace, Wix
